recentEntries.shortDescription: OsGeo GeoServer contains an XML injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to cause the server to read local text files accessible to the GeoServer process or fetch attacker-specified HTTP or HTTPS URLs via a crafted ID parameter in the WFS 2.0 GetFeatureById stored query. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-129244, CVE-2026-129243, CVE-2026-129245, and CVE-2026-129242 to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution on an affected GeoServer instance.

GeoServer contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass service-level role checks and invoke operations protected solely by those checks via a request with a prefixed service parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-129244, CVE-2026-120705, CVE-2026-129245, and CVE-2026-129242 to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution on an affected GeoServer instance.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Drupal Core Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Drupal Core contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to take over a site via the exposed Drupal installer when the site is in one of the affected unusual or incomplete installation states.

recentEntries.product: Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router
recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router OS Command Injection Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router contain an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands as root via a specially crafted salt minion ID.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Vates Xen Orchestra Improper Validation of Specified Type of Input Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Vates Xen Orchestra contains an improper validation of specified type of input vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication and perform actions with administrative privileges via a specially crafted authentication token containing an empty JSON object.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series Improper Authentication Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow an attacker to generate a web report exposing sensitive information, including internal IP addresses, usernames, and store names.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series Path Traversal Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow an attacker to access and read underlying server system files via the XML interface.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series contains an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to run arbitrary commands on the affected system.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Mitel MiCollab Not Failing Securely Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Mitel MiCollab contains a not failing securely vulnerability in the Audio, Web and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication controls and perform unauthorized actions.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Mitel MiCollab Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Mitel MiCollab contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability in the Audio, Web and Video Conferencing (AWV) component due to insufficient file type validation that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to upload arbitrary files.

Mitel MiCollab contains a weak authentication vulnerability in the Audio, Web and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access sensitive information using a specific system-generated random identifier or pre-staged content.

Mitel MiCollab contains an XML injection vulnerability in its Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands using pre-staged malicious content.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Mitel MiCollab OS Command Injection Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Mitel MiCollab contains an improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command (OS command injection) vulnerability in its Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary system commands.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Optimizely Web Experimentation External Control of Critical State Data Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Optimizely Web Experimentation contains an external control of critical state data vulnerability in its account signup flow that could allow an attacker to impersonate existing customer users and modify Project JavaScript. Successful exploitation can result in attacker-controlled JavaScript being distributed through Optimizely-hosted assets and executed in browsers visiting affected customer websites.

recentEntries.vulnerabilityName: Idunno AntiCsrf Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
recentEntries.shortDescription: Idunno AntiCsrf contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via object injection. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.
